name: Conformance: Context-Budget Multi-Turn Orchestrator (RFC 0111)
description: RFC 0111. Drives a multi-iteration `core.orchestrator.supervisor` loop so the per-turn transcript grows across iterations — enough turns that an UNBOUNDED transcript would exceed a host's advertised `multiAgent.executionModel.contextBudget.transcriptTokenBudget`. A host that bounds the transcript exposes its per-iteration accounting via the OPTIONAL seam `GET /v1/host/sample/agent/transcript-window?runId=…&iteration=N` (`host-sample-test-seams.md` §14): `{ tokenCounter, tokenCount, eventIds, summarizedRanges }`. The conformance scenario `context-budget-transcript-bound.test.ts` asserts `tokenCount ≤ budget`, independently re-counts the events named in `eventIds` from the run event-log, confirms the recent-tail + keepLastTurns-verbatim rules, and (for `summarization.supported` hosts) `context-summarization-replay.test.ts` replays the run and asserts the recorded `context.summarized` → `summaryRef` is reused (never re-summarized). Reference hosts that do not advertise `contextBudget` soft-skip both scenarios.
